objects.description: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) dumped NTDS.dit through creating volume shadow copies via vssadmin.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)
objects.description_fa: در طول [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051)، [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) NTDS.dit را با ایجاد کپی‌های سایه حجمی از طریق vssadmin حذف کرد.[[[ERVE_1]] (Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)
